newsitem.title: USA: Vanguard Cellular buys Virginia network.
newsitem.headline: Vanguard Cellular buys Virginia network.

text.p: Vanguard Cellular Systems Inc said Wednesday it had bought all of the assets of the West Virginia-6 RSA cellular telephone network for about $16.7 million as one of three recent transactions.
Vanguard, which operators cellular telephone systems, said it had also signed a definitive agreement with PriCellular Corp to swap interests in cellular networks.

It said it would exchange its 100-percent interest in the Orange County, New York MSA and some minority interests in other markets for PriCellular's 100-percent interest in Parkersburg, WV/Marietta, Ohio MSA and the Ohio-9 RSAs.
Vanguard said the two transactions would expand its West Virginia/Ohio/Kentucky network to encompass seven markets that serve a population exceeding 1.3 million.

It said it had bought all of the outstanding minority partnership interests in its State College, Pennsylvania, Williamsport, Pennsylvania and PA-10 East markets, each located within its Mid-Atlantic SuperSystem.
